mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(na.total_calories), 0.0) AS totalCalories, IFNULL(SUM(na.total_carbs), 0.0) AS totalCarbs, IFNULL(SUM(na.total_protein), 0.0) AS totalProtein, IFNULL(SUM(na.total_fat), 0.0) AS totalFat FROM VIDEOS v JOIN NUTRITION_ANALYSIS na ON v.id = na.video_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.meal_date = #{targetDate} AND na.status = 'DONE'

SELECT rfi.food_name FROM VIDEOS v JOIN NUTRITION_ANALYSIS na ON v.id = na.video_id JOIN RECOGNIZED_FOOD_ITEM rfi ON na.id = rfi.nutrition_analysis_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.meal_date = #{targetDate} AND na.status = 'DONE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILY_DIET_REPORT (user_id, report_date, ai_daily_feedback) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reportDate}, #{feedback}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ai_daily_feedback = #{feedback}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT v.meal_date AS date, IFNULL(SUM(na.total_calories), 0.0) AS dailyCalories, IFNULL(SUM(na.total_carbs), 0.0) AS dailyCarbs, IFNULL(SUM(na.total_protein), 0.0) AS dailyProtein, IFNULL(SUM(na.total_fat), 0.0) AS dailyFat FROM VIDEOS v JOIN NUTRITION_ANALYSIS na ON v.id = na.video_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.meal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND na.status = 'DONE' GROUP BY v.meal_date ORDER BY v.meal_date ASC
